Test Case Description: Event created on Device A should appear on Device B
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create event on Device A 2. Open events page on Device B 3. Check if event appears
Expected Result: Event should appear on both devices
Actual Result (Before Fix): Event only visible on Device A (IndexedDB local storage)
Fix Applied: Changed EventForm to use databaseAdapter instead of direct IndexedDB
Actual Result (After Fix): Event syncs via Neon cloud database
Notes: Root cause: EventForm imported from database.js instead of databaseAdapter.js
